# Daily Herald

> Local news, business directory, and community guide for the Chicago metropolitan area.

The Daily Herald serves the Chicago area with comprehensive local coverage including community news, business listings, events, and local offers. The site aggregates information about featured businesses, local shops, and community organizations across multiple suburbs and municipalities.

## Key Topics

- Chicago area news
- Local business directory
- Community guide
- Featured businesses
- Shop local
- Schaumburg
- Rosemont
- St Charles
- Batavia
- Local offers
- Business listings
- Community events
- Print advertising
- Local sports
- College of DuPage

## Local Guide & Community

- [Local Guide](https://admin.local.dailyherald.com/): Community news, local sports, events, and business directory for Chicago area
